title: Bacterial growth curve (OD600)
summary: Time-course OD600 measurement to track bacterial growth and compute doubling times.
hazardsMd: BSL-1 only. If using BSL-2 strains, run the assay inside the BSC and seal the plate before transferring to a containment-rated reader.
contentUndergrad:
## Reading interpretation
Log-phase: OD ~0.1 to 1.0. Above 1.0 the OD-to-cell-count relationship breaks down (multiple-scattering). Stationary phase: ~3-5 for most E. coli strains.

steps.title: Dilute overnight to start point
steps.instructionMd: Measure OD600 of overnight culture. Dilute to OD 0.05 in fresh pre-warmed media + appropriate antibiotic.
steps.verificationMd: Pre-dilution OD600 measured and logged. Post-dilution: 200 μL aliquot reads ~0.05.

steps.title: Load plate
steps.instructionMd: Pipette 200 μL of diluted culture per well. Run 3-6 technical replicates per condition. Include media-only blank wells (4+ for averaging).
steps.verificationMd: Plate map filed. No bubbles in wells (a 1-min spin at 500×g clears them).

steps.title: Set up the kinetic read
steps.instructionMd: In Gen5: kinetic read, 600 nm absorbance, 5-15 min interval, 18-24 hour total. Set incubator to 37 °C with double-orbital shaking 200 rpm.
steps.verificationMd: Program shows expected timepoint count and total duration. Shaker speed appropriate for the strain.

steps.title: Run the curve
steps.instructionMd: Lid on; some readers require lid-off + breathable seal to prevent condensation. Start the kinetic protocol.
steps.verificationMd: First few readings show expected baseline (OD ~0.05). Curve will be flat for the first 1-2 h (lag), then exponential.

steps.title: Analyze the curve
steps.instructionMd: Subtract media blank. For doubling time: fit log-phase region (OD 0.1-0.5) to exponential. Doubling time t_d = ln(2) × Δt / ln(OD2/OD1).
steps.verificationMd: Doubling time matches expectation for strain (~20 min for E. coli MG1655 in LB at 37 °C). Curves overlap across replicates within ~10%.
